name: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo V ~Nerawareta Tenshi~
original_name: 天使たちの午後V 〜狙われた天使〜
source:
Main character is a lover and a producer of a selling singer. An incident occurred in which the acquaintance was shot dead during the singer live performance ruining the event. Hero decides to start his own investigation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-january-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角既是一名畅销女歌手的恋人，也是她的制作人。歌手举行现场演出时，一名熟人遭人开枪杀害，整场活动也因此毁于一旦。主角决定亲自展开调查。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-january-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
